start.text: New joinee? No ID, no entry — rule is rule. Admin block, left side, ground floor. Ask for Prakash sir. Tell him I sent you — he will still make you wait.

badge.text: Ah, card is there. Tap, tap. Lift is on the right. Welcome, saar-madam.

night.text: (The night guard's torch finds you.) That boy has been there since eleven. I gave him tea. He didn't drink it. Generator's only for the gate — whole Whitefield is dark tonight.
